scope: PATH-01 affected global package listing inside the read-only configuration preview
status: implemented-and-isolated-ui-verified; real manager installation and real configuration write not performed
implementation: packages::global_package_rows exposes the existing disk-reading global inventory as read-only (name, version, detail) triples
pkgtools::read_affected_packages reads only the current global root; it never executes a manager, installs, updates or deletes
classify_affected_packages marks every existing package as unresolved when the command entry changes, and kept otherwise; unresolved_count reflects that
an empty read is described as 'not necessarily an empty directory' rather than claiming nothing is installed
a missing current global root is reported explicitly instead of producing an empty list that looks like a clean result
an unreadable global root produces a note with the underlying error and no fabricated packages
ToolConfigPreview carries affectedPackages (packages, unresolvedCount, note); the batch path reuses it per tool
the single-tool preview dialog lists the affected packages with name, version, optional diagnostic, and an 'entry may stop resolving' marker plus a total

uiCoverage.singlePreview: the preview dialog shows 受影响的全局包（当前全局目录）, the eslint 9.1.0 row marked as possibly unresolved, and the 1 个可能不再解析 total
uiCoverage.blockedPreview: the blocked pip preview carries an explicit 'no global directory found' note and never fabricates packages
